decisions.reason: The source requests editorial review of the supplied cover, not the suitability or selection of chapter illustrations.
The cover preference and cover review request do not change the manuscript editorial-polish requirements.
The same message independently introduces KDP upload assistance, which is already represented; the cover preference does not alter that requirement's current attributes.
Choosing a preferred base cover does not change the existing general guidance about paperback publication readiness.
The source concerns the paperback cover and KDP assistance, not integration of client-authored manuscript revisions.
Retaining and reviewing the supplied cover does not change requirements for chapter-image aspect ratio, cropping, or pixelation.
The cover decision does not modify the copyright page's publisher attribution or presentation.
The source selects a preferred cover asset but does not change chapter-image inclusion, placement, timing, or full-page treatment.
The cover preference has no effect on Chapter 12 heading hierarchy, capitalization, or subtitle formatting.
The cover selection does not alter the requirement to omit the literal newline artifact from the book title.
